gaps.name: task_conflation
gaps.question: How should exact prediction, probabilistic forecasting, nowcasting, early warning, and impact forecasting be separated?
gaps.testability: Report hazard-specific targets, horizons, information cutoffs, and decision outputs separately.

gaps.name: rare_event_scoring
gaps.question: Can a system improve extreme-event tail calibration without increasing unusable false alarms?
gaps.testability: Use proper probabilistic scores, exceedance calibration, miss/false-alarm curves, and impact-weighted loss.

gaps.name: source_state_uncertainty
gaps.question: How much do initial-condition and source-geometry uncertainties limit forecasts?
gaps.testability: Use synthetic truth and ensemble perturbations for atmosphere, rupture, bathymetry, and coastal states.

gaps.name: latency_accounting
gaps.question: Does model accuracy remain useful after data, compute, communication, and response latency?
gaps.testability: Measure end-to-end warning lead time and skill at fixed latency budgets.

gaps.name: distribution_shift
gaps.question: Do models remain calibrated under unusual events and changing sensor networks?
gaps.testability: Use temporal, spatial, event, and sensor-domain holdouts with drift diagnostics.

gaps.name: cross_hazard_transfer
gaps.question: Which representations transfer across hazards without forcing false physical similarities?
gaps.testability: Compare shared, hazard-specific, and shared-backbone/separate-head architectures.

gaps.name: prospective_validation
gaps.question: Can apparent forecast gains survive a strict information-time audit?
gaps.testability: Lock hindcast inputs and evaluate only information available before each forecast origin.

rejected_overclaims: A weather forecasting model automatically predicts earthquake rupture initiation.
A tsunami warning after an earthquake is an exact pre-event tsunami prediction.
An earthquake detector has discovered a reliable precursor.
Lower average error guarantees fewer deaths or better warnings.
A single universal model should replace hazard-specific physical simulators.
